name: shortcut-recorder
title: Shortcut Recorder
description: Shortcut recorder that checks the combo against browser and OS reserved keys on every platform (Ctrl+W, ⌘Q, Ctrl+T), the app's own bindings and keys that need AltGr on some layouts, then reads it back as ⌘ on Mac and Ctrl on Windows/Linux.

meta.summary: Checks a newly recorded keyboard shortcut against browser and OS reserved keys and the app's own bindings before it's saved.
catches: Combos the browser or OS keeps for itself, blocked from saving
Clashes with the app's existing bindings, naming the action
Keys that need AltGr on some keyboard layouts
Read-back for both Mac and Windows/Linux
limits: The reserved list covers common browsers and OSes; extensions and custom OS shortcuts are unknown
a11y: Recorder is a button with aria-pressed while recording, labelled and described by its status
Tab or Escape (with no modifiers) stops recording; Backspace/Delete clears
Status in a polite live region; blocking issues use role=alert
